text: Over the past 30 days, visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have highlighted concerns primarily about the food service. Two reviewers noted issues with the menu range and value, describing the offerings as limited and overpriced. One visitor found the venison chili bland and the smoked salmon salad an unusual combination, while another mentioned the lack of cups for water. Overall, the average rating was low, indicating that improvements in food quality and service are needed.

windows.60: Over the last 60 days, several visitors have raised concerns about the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting bland flavors and limited menu options. Some reviews also mentioned issues with service and wait times. One visitor specifically pointed out the lack of cups for water and felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. While there were positive comments about some healthy dishes, the overall feedback suggests a need to review and improve the dining experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported that the menu is limited, with some dishes described as bland or poorly prepared, and others noted that the pricing does not match the portion size or quality. Service problems were also mentioned, including long wait times and periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. While some healthy options were appreciated, overall satisfaction with food quality and variety remains low. Attention to improving menu offerings, food preparation, and service efficiency would likely address the main concerns raised.
